status: Qualified production bridge for native expert placement; full model executor and whole goal remain incomplete

implementation.ownership: Executor/backend-owned placement store bound to one borrowed immutable model and backend; both must outlive store. Serialized access. Caller releases each lease only after ALL queued consumers finish. No changes to model or CPU weight ownership.
implementation.reuse: Existing model-owned BnTrellisSource catalog and BnMoEExpertReader; existing pinned host LRU; existing GPU reservation/lease LRU. No alternate cache or arithmetic engine.
implementation.decode: Acquire/promote GPU hit; reserve decode slot before host read/upload on miss; host misses admit into RAM LRU; commit transfers immutable raw handle ownership and returns pinned GPU lease.
implementation.prefill: Borrow decode hits without promotion; misses reserve separate temporary capacity before reading/uploading. Host misses use bounded staging without RAM admission. Temporary stays charged/pending until last consumer completes, then all handles destroyed before reservation abort. Decode entries are never evicted for prefill scans.
implementation.backpressure: Pinned/full cache, unavailable policy capacity or same temporary key pending returns BUSY without reading or uploading. Executor may share one lease across consumers; it must wait for all before release.
implementation.rollback: Partial upload failures destroy acquired handles before aborting reservation; host pin released on all paths; output unchanged on failure. Store close refuses live leases.
implementation.telemetry: Reader bytes/time, host hit/miss counters; successful upload payload bytes/count and blocking allocation/upload wall time; decode and temporary cache payload/pin/reservation counters; staging size and live lease count.
implementation.allocation_scope: Host payload slab/staging are reserved at init; GPU slot is charged before upload allocation. Raw immutable uploader has no decoded or auxiliary layout cache. Payload budgets exclude metadata, allocator, CUDA/library/context and activation overhead.

references.catalog: 40 layers,384 experts; metadata only, no full forward admission
references.cases: 22 frames ×25 source widths =550 profiles per full run; R1/7/16/17/32/33/64/65/128/129/256, clipping0/10; both actual experts active
references.policy: Independent original weighted F32 slots and source ordered final outputs, unchanged since capture. Entire preserved reference corpus rehashed before execution. Two concurrent request states share leases until both finish.

validation.synthetic: Synthetic checkpoint/recording backend tests exercise reserve-before-allocation, combined payload peak, shared pinned hits, no-I/O BUSY paths, live-output rejection, prefill decode preservation, stale reservation rejection, shutdown refusal, all three partial upload failures, retry, disabled policy, source read failure and index invalidation.

sanitizer_harness_compile_warnings.kind: Clang unused static helpers in unchanged src/moe_cpu_kernels.c

payload_bounds.note: Window32 runs have only two active experts; reported maximum is live payload, not full device peak. Each source frame creates a fresh store, so total counters include22 repeated cold starts. Prefill runs include seeding one decode/RAM entry per frame.

limits: Production bridge API is implemented, but a full-model executor/generation/CLI has not been wired or admitted.
The probe still synchronizes requests explicitly between expert windows; asynchronous IO/transfer overlap, separate transfer-stall attribution and serving scheduling remain incomplete.
Actual arithmetic proof covers two expert triples. Synthetic reservation tests cover policies and rollback, not all384 real expert weights.

Reader byte counts may be served by OS page cache; no physical disk IO claim. Blocking upload timings include allocation and synchronous completion and are diagnostic, not matched performance benchmarks.
ASAN covers full550-profile decode and prefill corpora plus whole CPU MoE suite; CUDA memcheck covers selected25-width real frame for both policies, not the entire550-profile corpus.
Shared F16 FFN composition, heavy/fused tier scheduler, source <=8 specialized decode profile, compressed/indexed/shared-KV attention and Engram execution still require qualification.
No full-model accuracy, matched vLLM parity, throughput or tail-latency claim.
